body: The context manifest names WHAT the consultation prompt was assembled
from, never the content itself. Exactly three fields may appear:
preview_ref (a private store reference to the rendered proposal
preview), dialog_context_ref (None for ordinary S7.3 v1 consultation
turns; a reviewed bounded reference only under the self_mod_dialog
policy), and rollback_path_class (the closed vocabulary class).
No private raw text may ride in the manifest: references only,
resolved by the validator against the private store at replay time.
(the reviewed manifest policy carrier section). This file is the
